title: 第17章 我要走到最高第18章 夜游
slug: 长生从守书阁的太监开始
lines: 两天后，当初升的朝阳勉强驱散内官监高墙下的阴冷时，周刘培踉跄地跨出了那扇沉重的黑漆木门。
阳光刺得他眼睛生疼，他下意识地抬手遮挡，脚步虚浮，仿佛踩在云端。
空气中不再弥漫着霉味和血腥气，而是带着清晨露水的清新，这让他有种强烈的不真实感，恍如隔世。
短短两日，却仿佛在地狱走了一遭。内牢里的阴暗、潮湿、无声的恐吓，以及对面王太监日夜受刑的惨叫，早已将他的精神摧残到了极限。
此刻重见天日，他整个人像是得了一场大病，瘦脱了形，脸色蜡黄，眼神涣散，原本憨厚的脸上只剩下惊魂未定的恐惧。
他的脑子浑浑噩噩，直到看见门口那个负手而立、静静等待他的身影时，周刘培的眼泪才“唰”地一下涌了出来。
他哽咽着喊了一声，腿一软，几乎要瘫倒在地。
李叶青一个箭步上前，稳稳扶住了他。
触手之处，是周刘培仍在微微颤抖的身体。
李叶青心中叹息，轻轻拍着他的后背“没事了，回来就好。我在书阁备了饭菜，尚膳监那边也替你告了假。”
他将周刘培扶进书阁旁自己那间简陋的小屋，给他倒了杯温水。周刘培双手捧着杯子，咕咚咕咚一口气喝干，这才像是缓过一口气，但眼神里的恐惧仍未散去。
“青哥……我……我以为我这次死定了……”
周刘培的声音带着哭腔，断断续续地诉说着牢里的可怕。
李叶青静静地听着，没有打断。
他知道，周刘培需要倾诉，需要把那份蚀骨的恐惧释放出来。
许久，周刘培终于停了下来，情绪稍定。
肚子里传来一阵咕噜声，他不好意思地笑了笑，鼻子上吹起一个鼻涕泡。
一阵饭菜香味撩拨着鼻尖，让他食指大动。
“青哥嘿嘿”
“吃吧，专门为你做的，尝尝看比膳房的大师傅如何。”
周刘培闻言，一把抓起筷子，迫不及待地将盘中的饭菜往嘴里送，塞得太多，险些噎住。
李叶青赶忙递过一碗酒，他接过去直接灌下，辛辣的滋味冲得他眼角泛泪。
酒足饭饱，食物安抚了惊魂。
周刘培深吸一口气，眼神变得复杂而锐利“青哥，你知道我在内牢里听王培丰怎么说的吗？”
“他怎么说的？”
“他说，陷害我，只因他背后的贵人想塞个人进尚膳监！
而我无依无靠、无权无势，就为这个狗都不要的位置，就能被人随手弄死！这深宫里，人命真比草还贱啊！”
李叶默默添上酒，无言以对。
“所以我就想通了，我不能一直当个任人踩踏的小人物！
谁知道哪天就莫名其妙死了！
出来前，我求见了老祖宗，跪着求他收我当干儿子！
我就是要一步一步，一步一步爬到最高！
爬到再没人能随意摆布我的位置！”
content_en:
Two days later, when the rising sun barely dispelled the coldness under the high wall of the inner prison, Zhou Liupei staggered out of the heavy black lacquered wooden door.
The sunlight stung his eyes, and he subconsciously raised his hands to cover them. His steps were frivolous, as if he were stepping on clouds.
The air was no longer filled with the smell of mold and blood, but instead was filled with the freshness of morning dew, which gave him a strong sense of unreality, as if he was in another world.
In just two days, it felt like I had been through hell. The darkness, humidity, and silent threats in the inner cell, as well as the screams of Eunuch Wang being tortured day and night across from him, had already broken his spirit to the limit.
When he saw the light of day again, he looked as if he had suffered a serious illness. He had lost all shape, his face was sallow, his eyes were blurry, and only the shock of fear remained on his originally honest face.
His mind was confused, and it wasn't until he saw the figure standing at the door, hands behind his hands, waiting for him quietly that Zhou Liupei's tears burst out.
"Qing...Brother Qing!"
He choked and shouted, his legs went weak and he almost collapsed to the ground.
Li Yeqing stepped forward and supported him steadily.
The tentacle was Zhou Liupei's still trembling body.
Li Yeqing sighed in his heart and patted his back gently, "It's okay, just come back. I've prepared meals in the library, and Supervisor Shang also took a leave of absence for you."
He helped Zhou Liupei into his simple hut next to the library and poured him a glass of warm water. Zhou Liupei held the cup in both hands and drank it all in one breath. It seemed that he had breathed a sigh of relief, but the fear in his eyes had not dissipated.
"Brother Qing...I...I thought I was dead this time..."
Zhou Liupei's voice was filled with tears, and he told intermittently about the horror in prison.
Li Yeqing listened quietly without interrupting.
He knew that Zhou Liupei needed to talk and release the bone-gnawing fear.
After a long time, Zhou Liupei finally stopped and calmed down a bit.
There was a growl in his stomach, and he smiled sheepishly, blowing a snot bubble on his nose.
The aroma of food tickled the tip of his nose, making him move his index finger.
"Brother Qing hehe"
"Eat it, it's specially made for you. Try it and see how the chef in the kitchen likes it."
Hearing this, Zhou Liupei grabbed the chopsticks and couldn't wait to put the food on the plate into his mouth. He stuffed so much that he almost choked.
Li Yeqing hurriedly handed over a bowl of wine, and he took it and drank it directly. The spicy taste brought tears to his eyes.
There was plenty of wine and food, and the food soothed the fright.
Zhou Liupei took a deep breath, his eyes became complicated and sharp, "Brother Qing, do you know what Wang Peifeng said to me in the inner prison?"
"What did he say?"
"He said he framed me just because the noble man behind him wanted to put someone in Shangshan Prison!
And I am helpless, powerless, and just because of this position that no dog wants, I can be killed casually! In this deep palace, human life is really worth less than grass! "
Li Ye added wine silently, speechless.
“So I figured out, I can’t just be a nobody who can be stepped on all the time!
Who knows what day he will die inexplicably!
Before I came out, I begged to see my ancestor and begged him on my knees to accept me as his godson!
I just want to climb to the highest step by step!
Climb to a position where no one can manipulate me at will! "
